summary: Indivior filed an 8-K supplement to its definitive joint proxy/prospectus for its merger with Supernus, under which a wholly owned Indivior subsidiary will merge into Supernus, which survives as a wholly owned Indivior subsidiary; Indivior will be renamed Supernus, Inc. The S-4 (File No. 333-298637) registering merger shares was declared effective September 11, 2026. Special stockholder meetings for both companies are set for October 15, 2026. The supplement follows purported Supernus stockholder demand letters; terms, board recommendation and advisors are not detailed in the excerpt. Watch for deal-close timing and any litigation-driven delays.
